```yaml
name: Benchmarks

on:
  push:
    branches: [trunk]
  workflow_dispatch:

# Cancel in-progress runs for the same branch
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install dotslash
        uses: facebook/install-dotslash@latest

      - name: Run benchmarks
        run: |
          ./bench.sh
          mkdir -p benchmark_results
          cp -r benchmarks/* benchmark_results/

      - name: Push benchmark results
        uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@04702edda442b2e678b25b537cec683a1493fcb9
        with:
          commit_message: "Update benchmark results"
          branch: perf
          file_pattern: benchmark_results/*
          commit_options: "--allow-empty"

      - name: Show benchmark results
        run: |
          echo "## Benchmark Results" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "```json" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          cat benchmarks/*.json | jq -c . >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "```" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
```
